x: Runs became more frequent as she set out at lunchtime or in the evening with John, Mark Hutton and Paul Cooper. Soon Helen was fit enough to tackle a half-marathon and her first one, in the summer of 1988, was at Cambridge.

Futher back Steve Willimont looked unhappy but Tony Binda and Paul Cooper were running well. At the halfway stage a breakaway group of seven runners were forcing the pace with Graham Adams hanging on at the back.

Lionel Mann had an amazing run over quarter of an hour faster than last year while Paul Cooper was thrilled to bits with his effort. Then late that night came the news that in spite of everything we had indeed won the team race.
